items.titulo: NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL
items.resumen: NVIDIA released Auto Ontology, an Apache 2.0 library that generates a semantic layer from enterprise metadata. It grounds agent SQL in certified definitions and serves context through MCP, CLI and API. The post NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: If in doubt, delete the uv.lock file
items.resumen: I've been getting the occasional confusing Python dependency error since switching over to Python 3.15 and the rule I'm having to remember is: If in doubt, delete the uv.lock file Most of my projects are libraries which don't include a uv.lock file, since it's rude for a library dependency to lock versions for anything else that uses it. items.titulo: Meet qwenGPU: Qwen3.5-2B With 45 Compiled GPU Layers That Run CUDA
items.resumen: qwenGPU compiles a 4-lane SIMT GPU into Qwen3.5-2B as 45 untrained layers. The model writes every step of real CUDA launches itself, using Gated DeltaNet state as registers and memory. The post Meet qwenGPU: Qwen3.5-2B With 45 Compiled GPU Layers That Run CUDA appeared first on MarkTechPost .
